title: Memory corruption in DOM in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute…
description: A memory corruption vulnerability exists in the DOM component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the browser's sandbox by crafting a malicious HTML page. The issue is classified with high severity by Chromium security.
